question_text: Which statement best describes generative AI tools?

options.text: They are only for expert programmers.
They are versatile and can be used by non-technical users too.
Generative AI tools are difficult to use and require many different tools.
They are limited to text generation tasks.

A.text: Not quite. Many tools are designed for non-programmers too.

B.text: Yes! Generative AI tools are increasingly user-friendly and versatile.

C.text: This is outdated. Many tools now consolidate multiple capabilities.

D.text: They go beyond text, including image, audio, and video generation.

explanation: Generative AI tools are designed for broad use cases and are becoming more accessible to non-experts.
author: Ram
